title: World may warm by 25 per cent more than current projections suggest | New Scientist
description: 'Official' projections for how much the world will warm are already catastrophic, and now it appears they significantly underestimate future warming
author: Michael Le Page

title: Female clones created from the blood of male mice | New Scientist
description: A CRISPR-based tool can perform sex reversal on male mouse embryos, reliably turning them into healthy females – a feat that could be valuable for conservation
author: Chris Simms

title: Postbiotic could reduce the risk of brain damage after a concussion | New Scientist
description: Giving mice a byproduct produced by gut bacteria reduced their risk of severe brain damage and cognitive difficulties after a traumatic brain injury
author: Rachel Melegrito

title: Did humans evolve to be active throughout the day and night? | New Scientist
description: Evidence from hunter-gatherers suggests humans aren't diurnal but cathemeral, with bouts of activity at nighttime – a sleep pattern similar to some lemurs
author: Michael Marshall

title: Planes flying over the Atlantic will be re-routed to avoid contrails | New Scientist
description: Operation Blue Skies is the world’s first trial to deploy contrail avoidance measures across an entire airspace, aiming to lower the climate impact of flights on a large scale
author: Madeleine Cuff

title: Physicists may have solved a 30-year mystery over missing neutrinos | New Scientist
description: Since the 1990s, researchers have wondered if unexpected results from gallium-based neutrino detectors are a sign of a new kind of particle, but a new study suggests that revising their calculations could explain the anomaly
author: Karmela Padavic-Callaghan
